mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.2pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% each over the past month signals a broad-based demand contraction, which is followed by negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary easing cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS declining for at least 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS declining for 3+ months), SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% indicates a sharp slowdown in manufacturing activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO falls by >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts exceeding 1.5% signals a weakening housing market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when HOUST falls by >1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate (indicating a monetary easing response to labor market deterioration) is followed by positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises by >0.2pp in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing contraction (INDPRO falling for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In manufacturing contraction periods (INDPRO falling for 2+ months), SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
